question: Which Indian boxer won a bronze medal in the middleweight division in boxing at the 2008 Beijing Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijender Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian boxer and politician** Vijender Singh is a **pro boxer.**
 
• He became the **first boxer **from India to win an **Olympic medal** when he took home the** bronze medal** at the** 2008 Beijing Games.**
 
• He also took home** bronze** at the** 2010 Commonwealth Games** and the **2009 World Championships.**
 
• At the **Commonwealth Games in 2006 and 2014**, he also took home **silver medals **in the **middleweight division**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mary Kom:**

 
 
• Mary Kom is a** former Rajya Sabha member**, **politician**, and **amateur boxer** from India.
 
• In** 2014** at the** Asian Games in Incheon**, South Korea, **she became the first female boxer** from India to take home a **gold medal.**
 
• She is the** first female boxer** from India to win a** gold medal **at a** Commonwealth Games.**
 
 
 
• **Akhil Kumar:**
 
 
• **Boxer **Akhil Kumar is from India.
 
• He received the **Arjuna Award** from the Indian government in **2005** for his contributions to world boxing.
 
 
 
• **Jitender Kumar:**
 
 
• Jitender Kumar is a** flyweight boxer** from India.
 
• In the flyweight division, he took home the** bronze medal **from the **2006 Commonwealth Games. **
